items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: We had that twice, but Joe cooked it. I think Joe cooked it in England.

ctx.x: over there? How did you like it?

Well, the food was nice. I enjoyed the food because, and I say, it wasn't red beans and rice. We had that twice, but Joe cooked it. I think Joe cooked it in England. I know Joe cooked it. But other than that, the other food, you get chicken and fish and you have rice, liver, and they got a lot of places there where you can get this fine food. We ate in the Chinaman, the Salve, and we ate in a restaurant they called Simpson's Restaurant. And it's a modern restaurant. I mean, it's nothing in the States with no…
